group_assessment.weighting: Same laboratory as PMID 27869163 (Huebner last, Aldaz co-author), and the weighting splits the same way but on a different axis. What is first-hand here is the Wwox side: the Wwox antibody is the Huebner lab's own (Table 1: 'Wwox | Huebner Lab'), and the WT/KO MEF clones are the group's. What is NOT theirs is the entire mouse-genetics apparatus that makes this paper's central claim possible: every mutant MEF line - Brca1 dex11, Brca1 M1717R, Brca1 S1598F, Brca1FHWT, Brip1FHWT, the ABC triple phospho-site mutant, Bard1-/-;53BP1-/-, the PimDRGFP reporter line, the 31-03 mammary and KPC-2 pancreatic tumour lines - was 'obtained from the laboratory of Dr. Thomas Ludwig', and the Brca1 and Abraxas antisera are from the Ludwig lab while the CtIP monoclonal is from the Baer lab. Reczek, third author, comes from that side (33 papers, 6 with BRCA1, and refs 33, 34, 40, 46 are his). So the BRCT-domain genetics is expert and externally sourced, the Wwox reagents are the group's own, and the interpretation is the group's. This matters for weighting because the strongest experiments here - the M1717R and ABC mutant co-IPs - are strong precisely because the reagents come from a laboratory with no stake in WWOX.

entries.proposition: Figure 4A read as pixels, and it settles which clones the resection measurement used: the in-panel legend names WT3, WT7, Wwox KO3 and Wwox KO5, matching Methods 4.7 and not the WT3/WT4 pair named in the legends of the foci panels. The distributions are bimodal and fully separated - wild-type fibres peak at 1-2 microns at about 50% frequency while both knockout clones peak at 5-10 microns at about 47%.

entries.proposition: Figure 5B's inset immunoblot names the clones used for the carboplatin arm - WT4, WT7, KO3 and KO5 - and shows the Chk2 silencing it depends on, with Wwox absent in the two KO clones.
entries.snippet: Figure 5B inset, 400 dpi page render: an immunoblot with four clone groups labelled WT4, WT7, KO3 and KO5, each with siCont and siChk2 lanes, probed for Wwox, Chk2 and Vinculin; the Wwox row is blank in the KO3 and KO5 groups.

entries.proposition: Figure 6 read as pixels: unlike the 2017 model figure, this one carries no question mark or hedging glyph on any arrow. Every step - Wwox blocking BRCT complex formation, Wwox blocking Brip1-mediated CtIP-MRN recruitment, resection inhibiting NHEJ and promoting aberrant HR/SSA - is drawn as an assertion, including the mutagenicity endpoint.
entries.snippet: Figure 6, 400 dpi page render: two columns headed WT (Wwox +) and KO (Wwox -); the WT column shows Wwox bound to Brca1-BRCT and to Brip1 with an arrow through Ku/DNA-PKcs to NHEJ, the KO column shows increased MRN-CtIP, Brip1-mediated CtIP-MRN recruitment, resection, RPA and Rad51, with a blunt-ended line to NHEJ and an arrow to Aberrant HR/SSA. No interrogative mark appears anywhere in the panel.

entries.proposition: Figure 2's co-IP series read as pixels: all five panels are nuclear-fraction IPs with empty-vector or non-expressing-line negative controls, and the Brca1-independence argument rests on two different Brca1 states, one per panel. In panel D the Input Brca1 row is reduced but present in the siBrca1 lane (band-mean grey deficit about 23 against about 79-80 in the WT and siC lanes). In panel E the Input Brca1 row has no detectable band in the Bard1-/- lane (deficit about 2, inside the background spread, while the same lane carries CtIP, Myc-Wwox and Wwox bands), consistent with the legend's 'Brca1 protein is unstable' in Bard1-/-;53BP1-/- cells. Panel E's control therefore rests on Brca1 being undetectable, not merely reduced. Measured on the embedded 814x191 px raster files/figures/PMID35409089/PDFp5_xref163.png (about 150 dpi as placed), grey 0=black 255=white, in-blot background about 122-124.

audit.method: legend-locator-audit, blind R4: triples plus source artefacts only, no dossier, no manifest, no reader identity; separate agent with no session history, 2026-09-14, dispatched by orchestrator under mandate ALDAZ-EXEC-20260913. Verdict OVERSHOOT on the panel E clause. Auditor measured the embedded raster PDFp5_xref163.png at native 814x191 px and at a 4x upscale: panel D Input Brca1 lane 3 deficit about 15-28 against 65-75 in lanes 1-2 (band present, reduced); panel E Input Brca1 lane 3 reads 119-124 across the row (deficit about 0), window validated by lane-3 CtIP (~70-74) and Wwox bands in the same x-range. Re-measured independently by the reader (scientist-c, ALDAZ-LOCATOR-REV-C-20260914) on the same native raster, band means over lane boxes: D background 123-124, lanes 44.4 / 43.7 / 100.3; E background 122, lanes 73.0 / 70.4 / 120.4, darkest lane-3 pixel over the whole row 117; E lane-3 controls CtIP 79.1 (min 44), Myc-Wwox 83.5 (min 49), Wwox 57.6 (min 38). The reader's measurement agrees with the auditor on both panels; the amendment was applied with the panel E clause re-expressed in the reader's own band-mean figures. The 400 dpi page render resamples the same 814 px raster and adds no resolution.
